name: Hurricane Lowell
description: Follow Hurricane Lowell, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: State of emergency in Hawaii as Hurricane Lowell approaches
changes.summary: Hurricane Lowell is barreling toward Hawaii, bringing the potential for life-threatening floods. CBS News' Carter Evans is in Kauai with more. Then, Rob Marciano joins with the latest forecast.

changes.title: Hurricane warning issued for western Hawaii as Lowell approaches
changes.summary: The National Hurricane Center posted a hurricane warning for western Hawaii's Kauai County as Hurricane Lowell moved toward the area as a Category 2 storm.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Hurricane Lowell first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Hurricane Lowell expected to impact Hawaii overnight
changes.summary: Hurricane Lowell has turned northward and is expected to pass close to Hawaii overnight Monday into Tuesday, bringing hurricane-force winds and heavy rainfall. CBS News correspondent Carter Evans reports from Kauai.

changes.title: Hurricane Lowell nears Hawaii, prompting warnings for 3 islands
changes.summary: Hurricane Lowell is expected to pass to the west of the Hawaiian islands of Kauai and Niihau. A hurricane warning is in effect for both, with a tropical storm warning for Oahu.
